text.p: Carmike Cinemas Inc and Wal-Mart Stores Inc said Thursday they had formed a joint venture to develop and operate family entertainment centers.
The first center will open in Goshen, Ind., late this summer, to be followed by an autumn 1997 opening in Valparaiso, Ind., and a spring 1998 opening in Dekalb, Ill.
The entertainment centers will feature movie theaters, skating rinks, arcades, a sit-down restaurant, and a variety of other attractions.
Carmike Cinemas owns 50 percent of the joint venture and will manage the entertainment centers.
Wal-Mart owns the other 50 percent and will oversee the real estate and development aspects of the venture.
Wal-Mart operates 2,300 stores and 436 Sam's Clubs in the United States.
Carmike is the largest motion picture exhibitor in the United States in terms of the number of theaters and screens operated.
